items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 54:1
items.html: (To the question) What is externality? The three Partzufim of the Aba and Ima of the back are called by the name externality, because they are the aspect of VAK and the Mochin of VAK, and every VAK is called by the name externality. And sometimes only the body of the VAK is called by the name externality, and the Mochin of VAK are called by the name the internality of the externality. (Item 60).
